user.title: Connect to Comelit Intercom
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Comelit intercom. Recommended: create a dedicated user in the device web UI (http://<ip>:8080/users.html → add user → generate activation code) and paste the activation code here — a dedicated identity is required for local (cloud-free) doorbell events. Otherwise leave both empty to auto-extract the token using the default 'comelit' password.

data_description.port: ICONA Bridge port (default 64100 - leave as-is unless you use port forwarding)
data_description.activation_code: Mints a dedicated token for Home Assistant (best for local events; won't clash with the app/monitor)
data_description.token: Advanced: use an existing user token instead of an activation code

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device
error.auto_token_failed: Failed to extract token automatically. Please check that the device is accessible and using the default 'comelit' password, or enter your token manually.

data_description.enable_notifications: Receive real-time ring events via Comelit's cloud (FCM). Requires the device to have internet access.
data_description.push_token: Advanced: enroll push under a different ICONA token so a paired phone keeps its own notifications. Leave empty to use the main token.
